metadata.scenario: A new customer contacts the support team to complain about the poor installation service they experienced. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint. Customer type: new_customer.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, this is Rose Patterson. I’m calling to express my concerns about the service I received. I’m sorry to hear that, Rose. Can you tell me more about the issue? Well, I had a caregiver come yesterday for my mother, and the installation of the equipment was just… poorly done. I apologize for that. What specifically was wrong with the installation? The caregiver didn’t set up the mobility aids correctly, and my mother almost fell trying to use them. It was really concerning. That sounds very serious. I’m really sorry for the trouble caused. We take safety very seriously. I just want to ensure that it doesn’t happen again. Absolutely, I understand. I will escalate this to our Client Services Manager, Angela Martinez. Can you ensure she gets back to me with a solution? Yes, I’ll make sure she contacts you directly. Can I have your best phone number for her to reach you? It’s +13165559876. Thank you, Rose. I’ll pass that along to Angela. I just feel like the caregivers need more training on setup. It’s crucial for safety. I completely agree. Training is essential for quality care. Also, I’d like to discuss adding medication management services for my mother. Certainly, I can connect you with our Director of Nursing, Margaret Thompson, for that. That would be great, thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to address while I have you on the line? No, just hoping for a prompt follow-up on the installation issue. Understood. I will ensure Angela follows up promptly. Thank you for your help. You're welcome, Rose. Have a great day! You too, goodbye. Goodbye!
